captions.story: Lake Baikal holds 20% of Earth's freshwater and conceals secrets millions of years old deep beneath its ice.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of Lake Baikal?
story.summary: This episode explores Lake Baikal, the deepest and oldest lake on Earth, highlighting its unique endemic wildlife, mysterious ice rings formed by methane vents, and the miles-thick ancient sediment on its bed.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of Lake Baikal?
